_comment: Every coefficient used by simulate.py and evaluate.py. Values marked PLACEHOLDER are demo defaults to recalibrate from the full one-year datasets or local surveys; sources are indicative, not citations.

demand._comment: Daily volumes are MEASURED, not set here: simulate.py reads them from data/calibration.json (built by trips.py from the observed bike_trips.geojson, ~11-12 trips/day). Larger volumes are explicit growth hypotheses passed as --scale; the labels below are the ones the demo presents. The behavioural parameters remain ASSUMED. Kept in v3: the replay stress test still reads the behavioural parameters below (walk catchment, retries, detour factor, ride speed). The growth_scenarios block is DEPRECATED (no "x25" in v3).

rebalancing._comment: dispatch_fixed_cost_eur and unit_cost_eur_per_bike_km are read at runtime from network-design-bss/src/util/cost.py (CostParameters.dispatch_fixed_cost, .rebalancing_unit_cost), not set here. truck_capacity_bikes (here) and, in the demand block, walk_catchment_m and ride_speed_kmh mirror network-design-bss/src/util/util.py (CAPACITY_REBALANCING_VEHICLE, WALK_CATCHMENT_RADIUS, RIDE_SPEED respectively) and are pinned by demo/experiments/tests/test_src_parity.py.

costs._comment: station_setup_cost_eur, dock_cost_eur and unit_bike_cost_eur are read at runtime from network-design-bss/src/util/cost.py (CostParameters), not set here, so simulated CAPEX can never silently drift from what the optimiser spent. truck_capacity_bikes (in rebalancing) and, in the demand block, walk_catchment_m and ride_speed_kmh mirror network-design-bss/src/util/util.py (CAPACITY_REBALANCING_VEHICLE, WALK_CATCHMENT_RADIUS, RIDE_SPEED respectively) and are pinned by demo/experiments/tests/test_src_parity.py. The three keys below (amortization_years, maintenance_eur_per_bike_per_day, fare_eur_per_trip) are DEPRECATED (demo v3, 2026-09-15): the v3 demonstration reports investment against served demand as the paper does, with no fare, maintenance or amortisation assumption; removed once the paper-grid runs are validated.

mode_substitution._comment: What a served bike-share trip replaces. PLACEHOLDER: mid-range of European bike-share user surveys (car share is deliberately conservative for a dense city centre). Must sum to 1. DEPRECATED (demo v3, 2026-09-15): replaced by the paper's own evaluation (evaluate.paper_kpis reads the model's solved plan); no longer read by the demo, removed once the paper-grid runs are validated.

unserved_fallback._comment: What an unserved would-be rider does instead. Must sum to 1. DEPRECATED (demo v3, 2026-09-15): replaced by the paper's own evaluation (evaluate.paper_kpis reads the model's solved plan); no longer read by the demo, removed once the paper-grid runs are validated.

emission_factors_g_per_pkm._comment: Lifecycle gCO2e per passenger-km, mobitool-style Swiss values. Bike fleet factor is the observed mix: 75% mechanical (8 g) / 25% e-bike (25 g). DEPRECATED (demo v3, 2026-09-15): replaced by the paper's own evaluation (evaluate.paper_kpis reads the model's solved plan); no longer read by the demo, removed once the paper-grid runs are validated.

equivalences._comment: Broad-audience translations of kg CO2e. DEPRECATED (demo v3, 2026-09-15): replaced by the paper's own evaluation (evaluate.paper_kpis reads the model's solved plan); no longer read by the demo, removed once the paper-grid runs are validated.
